## 1. Read data

**Read raw data files under target directory**

```{r}
# Set parent path of target folder
parent_folder <- "../../3_Data/RawData/"

# Create empty list to store all file paths
file_list <- c()

file_list <- list.files(
    path = parent_folder,
    pattern = "*exp3_subj.*\\.csv$", 
    full.names = TRUE
  )

# Create an empty list to store all datasets
df_list_1 <- list()

# Read files one by one and store (use original filename as list element name)
for (file in file_list) {
  # Get filename without file extension
  file_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))  
  # Store dataset into lis
  tryCatch({
    df_list_1[[file_name]] <- read.csv(file)
  })
}

# Check number and names of loaded files
cat("Total loaded files:", length(df_list_1), "\n")
print(names(df_list_1))
```
## 2. Data cleaning

```{r}
# Create output folder if it does not exist
output_path <- "../../3_Data/CleanData"
if (!dir.exists(output_path)) {
  dir.create(output_path, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Process each dataset in loop
for (file_name in names(df_list_1)) {
  data <- df_list_1[[file_name]]

  # Extract participant information
  participant_info <- data[data$part == "survey", "response"]
  participant_info <- gsub("[{}\"]", "", participant_info) # 去掉多余的字符
  info_list <- strsplit(participant_info, ",")[[1]]

  # Create new dataframe for participant metadata
  participant_data <- data.frame(
    subj_idx = file_name,
    Sex = as.character(NA),
    Age = as.numeric(NA),
    Handedness = as.character(NA),
    Color_blindness = as.character(NA),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Split character string by underscore
  split_data <- strsplit(participant_data$subj_idx, "_")
  participant_data$subj_idx <- as.numeric(lapply(split_data, function(x) {
    gsub("[^0-9]", "", x[[3]]) 
  }))

  for (info in info_list) {
    key_value <- strsplit(info, ":")[[1]]
    key <- trimws(key_value[1])
    value <- trimws(key_value[2])
    if (key == "sex"){
      participant_data$Sex <- switch(
        value, "男" = 1, "女" = 2
      )
    }
    if (key == "age") participant_data$Age <- as.numeric(value)
    if (key == "hands") participant_data$Handedness <- value
    if (key == "color_blindness") participant_data$Color_blindness <- value
  }

  # Extract behavioral data
  behavior_data <- data[
    data$part %in% c("RDK_overlap","RDK_color","RDK_shape"),
    c(
      "part", "rt", "response", "correct", "dot_color","dot_shape", 
      "association"
    )
  ]
  
  # Extract formal experimental trials
  official_trials <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(unique(behavior_data$part), function(part) {
    part_data <- behavior_data[behavior_data$part == part, ]
    if (part %in% c("RDK_overlap", "RDK_color", "RDK_shape")) {
      return(part_data[-(1:16), ]) 
    } else {
      return(NULL)
    }
  })
)

  # Combine participant metadata and behavioral data
  final_data <- cbind(participant_data, official_trials)

  # Export cleaned dataset to CSV
  output_file <- file.path(output_path, paste0(file_name, "_Clean.csv"))
  write.csv(final_data, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

**Read cleaned datasets**

```{r message=FALSE}
# Set relative path for target folder
folder_path <- "../../3_Data/CleanData"

# List all CSV files matching pattern "*exp3_subj_*.csv"
file_list <- list.files(
  path = folder_path,
  pattern = "*exp3_subj_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE
)

# Create empty list to store datasets
df_list_1 <- list()

for (file in file_list) {
  file_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
  df <- read_csv(file, col_types = cols(
    correct = col_logical(),
    .default = col_guess() 
  ))
  df_list_1[[file_name]] <- df
}
data <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_list_1)

rm(participant_info, info_list, participant_data, split_data,
   behavior_data, official_trials, final_data, output_file, file, file_list,
   file_name, folder_path, info, key, key_value, value)
```

## 3. Demographic summary statistics
```{r}
df.basic <- data %>%
  dplyr::select(subj_idx, Age, Sex) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(subj_idx, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    subj_group = dplyr::case_when(
      subj_idx >= 1 & subj_idx <= 40 ~ "Group1 (motion)",
      subj_idx >= 40 & subj_idx <= 80 ~ "Group2 (color)",
    )
  ) %>%
  # dplyr::group_by(subj_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    N = length(subj_idx), 
    Nf = length(Sex[Sex == "2"]),
    Nm = length(Sex[Sex == "1"]),
    Age_mean = round(mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE), 2), 
    Age_sd = round(sd(Age, na.rm = TRUE), 2), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df.basic
```
## 4. Further data preprocessing

**Define functions to compute mean RT, accuracy, and self‑other difference (SPE)**

```{r}
# Compute mean accuracy and reaction time
compute_rt_acc <- function(data){
  data <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(part %in% c("RDK_overlap","RDK_color","RDK_shape")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(rt != -1) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(subj_idx, part, association) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      # rt = mean(rt, na.rm = TRUE), 
      rt = mean(rt[correct == 1], na.rm = TRUE), 
      acc = sum(correct == 1, na.rm = TRUE) / n()
    )
  
  return(data)
}

# Compute self‑other difference (SPE effect size)
compute_diff <- function(data, keepMatch=FALSE){
  group_vars <- if(keepMatch) {
    c("subj_idx", "part")
  } else {
    c("subj_idx", "part")
  }
  
  data_agg <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(part %in% c("RDK_overlap","RDK_color","RDK_shape")) %>%
    dplyr::group_by_at(group_vars) %>% 
    dplyr::summarise(
      rt_other = mean(rt[association == "other"], na.rm = TRUE),
      rt_self = mean(rt[association == "self"], na.rm = TRUE),
      acc_other = mean(acc[association == "other"], na.rm = TRUE),
      acc_self = mean(acc[association == "self"], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Calculate difference scores
  data_result <- data_agg %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      rt_diff_os = rt_other - rt_self, # Positive value = self advantage (faster for self)
      acc_diff_so = acc_self - acc_other # Positive value = self advantage (higher accuracy for self)
    )
  
  return(data_result)
}
```

**Extract shape‑group and color‑group datasets separately**

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  dplyr::filter(rt >= 100 & rt <= 3000, !is.na(rt)) 
# shape association group
data1 <- data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    subj_idx %in% c( seq(1, 40))) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(correct = as.numeric(as.logical(correct))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(subj_idx, part) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(subj_acc = mean(correct, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


data_shape <- data1 %>%
  dplyr::select(
    subj_idx, rt, correct, part, response, association, dot_color, dot_shape
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(correct = as.numeric(as.logical(correct))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rt = rt / 1000) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = "shape") 

# output_file <- base::file.path(output_path, "data_motion.csv")
# utils::write.csv(data_motion, output_file, row.names = FALSE)


data_shape_rt_acc <- compute_rt_acc(data1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = "shape") 


data_shape_diff <- compute_diff(data_shape_rt_acc) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(subj_idx = as.factor(subj_idx))

# Color
data2 <- data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    subj_idx %in% c( seq(41, 80))) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(correct = as.numeric(as.logical(correct))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(subj_idx, part) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(subj_acc = mean(correct, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

data_color <- data2 %>%
  dplyr::select(
    subj_idx, rt, correct, part, response, association, dot_color, dot_shape
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(correct = as.numeric(as.logical(correct))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rt = rt / 1000) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = "color") 


data_color_rt_acc <- compute_rt_acc(data2) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = "color")


data_color_diff <- compute_diff(data_color_rt_acc) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(subj_idx = as.factor(subj_idx))

data_color_diff <- compute_diff(data_color_rt_acc) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(subj_idx = as.factor(subj_idx))
```


**Merge and save final datasets**
```{r}
data_sbfa <- dplyr::bind_rows(data_color_rt_acc, data_shape_rt_acc) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    task_type = case_when(
      # Rules for color‑associated group
      group == "color" & part == "RDK_color" ~ "relevant",
      group == "color" & part == "RDK_shape" ~ "irrelevant",
      # Rules for shape‑associated group
      group == "shape" & part == "RDK_color" ~ "irrelevant",
      group == "shape" & part == "RDK_shape" ~ "relevant",
      # identity‑choice task
      part == "RDK_overlap" ~ "overlap",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

output_file <- base::file.path(output_path, "data_sbfa.csv")
utils::write.csv(data_sbfa, output_file, row.names = FALSE)

# Export aggregated dataset
data_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(data_color, data_shape) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    task_type = case_when(
      group == "color" & part == "RDK_color" ~ "relevant",
      group == "color" & part == "RDK_shape" ~ "irrelevant",
      group == "shape" & part == "RDK_color" ~ "irrelevant",
      group == "shape" & part == "RDK_shape" ~ "relevant",
      part == "RDK_overlap" ~ "overlap",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

output_file <- base::file.path(output_path, "data_all.csv")
utils::write.csv(data_all, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
```
